nodes.description: External payable deposit entry point; guarded by nonReentrant and onlyActiveReserve/onlyUnfreezedReserve/onlyAmountGreaterThanZero; mints aTokens and moves funds into the core.
Redeem entry point invoked by the overlying aToken; transfers underlying back to the user via the core.
Borrow entry point; performs LTV/health-factor and stable-rate validations then transfers liquidity to the borrower.
Repay entry point supporting repayment on behalf of another user and ETH/ERC20 flows.
Swaps a user borrow position between stable and variable rate modes.
Rebalances a user stable borrow rate when the market liquidity rate exceeds the user rate.
Enables/disables a deposit as collateral, delegating the safety check to the data provider.
Liquidation entry point that delegatecalls into the liquidation manager returned by the addresses provider.
Flash loan entry point; transfers liquidity to an arbitrary receiver, invokes executeOperation and verifies repayment plus fee.
Core transfer helper sending ERC20 via SafeERC20 or raw ETH via call.value to a user.
Core transfer helper pulling ERC20 from a user or accepting ETH and refunding the excess.
Core transfer helper sending fees to the token distributor.
Core helper sending accrued fees to the fee destination during liquidation.
Core state mutator invoked on borrow; updates reserve and user borrow records and interest rates.
aToken redeem entry point; cumulates user balance, burns tokens and calls pool.redeemUnderlying.
Only-lending-pool mint of aTokens on deposit.
Only-lending-pool burn of aTokens during liquidation.
Only-lending-pool aToken transfer during liquidation.
Redirects the interest stream of the caller or of another user (with allowance) to a target address.
Internal aToken transfer pipeline that cumulates balances, updates redirected balances and calls super._transfer.
Internal routine accruing interest, minting tokens to the user and updating the user index.
Private helper performing a low-level call on a token address and validating the optional return value.
Mutex modifier implementation using _guardCounter to detect reentrant calls.
Only-lending-pool mutator flipping the useAsCollateral flag of a user reserve record.
Returns the compounded aToken balance including accrued and redirected interest.
Stores an allowance allowing a third party to redirect the caller interest stream.
Reference to the LendingPoolCore contract holding all funds.
Registry contract used to resolve protocol component addresses.
Mapping of reserve address to ReserveData struct holding all reserve accounting.
Mapping user/reserve to UserReserveData holding principal borrows, fees and collateral flags.
Address of the underlying asset represented by the aToken.
Mapping of user to last recorded liquidity index used for balance compounding.
Mapping of user to the balance redirected to it by other accounts.
Mapping of user to the address to which its interest is redirected.
Reentrancy mutex counter, incremented and validated by the nonReentrant modifier.
Owner address controlling privileged administrative functions.
Mapping of account to principal token balance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, accounting and transfer destinations.
Block timestamp used for interest accrual and stored as user/reserve last update.
Origin address of the transaction; declared but not used for authorization in this codebase.
delegatecall from LendingPool.liquidationCall into an address provided by the addresses provider, executing arbitrary code in pool storage context.
Raw call.value gas-forwarding transfers of ETH to user supplied addresses in LendingPoolCore.
add/mul/div operations on borrow amounts, fees and liquidity that rely on SafeMath/WadRayMath for overflow safety.
address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20 bypassing Solidity return-data size checks.
Reserve address provided by the caller to deposit into.
Amount of underlying asset to deposit.
Arbitrary contract address receiving the flash loan and executing the callback.
Amount of liquidity requested for the flash loan.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the flash loan receiver callback.
Destination address for the redirected interest stream.
Amount of aTokens the user wants to redeem, or uint256(-1) for the full balance.
Address receiving the minted aTokens.
Local snapshot of core liquidity before the flash loan, used in the repayment check.
Local computed total flash loan fee.
Local computed protocol portion of the flash loan fee.
Memory struct aggregating borrow computation values to avoid stack-too-deep.
Effective amount being redeemed after handling the uint256(-1) sentinel.
Local copy of the guard counter compared after execution to detect reentrancy.
Callback invoked on the untrusted flash loan receiver contract during flashLoan.
Access control modifier restricting privileged functions to the stored owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the depositor credited and the aToken recipient in deposit.
block.timestamp is embedded in the emitted Deposit event and in core state updates triggered by deposit.
deposit is protected by the nonReentrant mutex modifier.
deposit calls aToken.mintOnDeposit to mint the overlying tokens.
deposit calls core.transferToReserve to move funds into the core, with a value transfer for ETH.
msg.sender is the borrower whose collateral data is evaluated in borrow.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Borrow event and stored as lastUpdateTimestamp through core state updates.
borrow uses the nonReentrant guard.
borrow performs fee and collateral arithmetic on user-controlled amounts before state changes.
msg.sender must equal _onBehalfOf when repaying the maximum amount on behalf of a user.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Repay event and recorded in user/reserve lastUpdateTimestamp.
repay uses the nonReentrant guard around external transfers.
repay forwards the origination fee through core.transferToFeeCollectionAddress.
repay returns the repaid principal through core.transferToReserve.
msg.sender identifies the user whose borrow rate mode is swapped.
swapBorrowRateMode uses the nonReentrant guard.
The caller triggers rebalancing of an arbitrary user position identified by _user.
rebalanceStableBorrowRate is guarded by nonReentrant.
msg.sender is the user whose collateral flag is being toggled.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral uses the nonReentrant guard.
The pool calls core.setUserUseReserveAsCollateral which enforces the onlyLendingPool caller check.
msg.sender is passed into the delegatecalled liquidation manager whose authorization logic is external.
liquidationCall uses the nonReentrant guard before delegatecalling the manager.
liquidationCall delegatecalls into the liquidation manager address obtained from the addresses provider.
msg.sender is the flash loan initiator whose fee liability is tracked.
block.timestamp is emitted in the FlashLoan event and recorded in reserve timestamps after the callback.
flashLoan is protected by the nonReentrant guard during the external callback.
flashLoan invokes executeOperation on the caller-supplied receiver contract, handing control to untrusted code.
The receiver callback re-enters the pool while the flash loan accounting is still in flight.
flashLoan transfers the borrowed liquidity to the receiver through core.transferToUser.
The pre-callback liquidity snapshot is compared after the callback to validate repayment.
The total fee is computed from the requested amount and basis-point parameters.
The protocol fee is derived arithmetically from the total fee.
transferToUser sends ETH with a raw call.value to a user controlled address.
transferToUser uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer for ERC20 reserves.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH with a raw call.value to the user.
liquidateFee sends ETH fees with a raw call.value.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress pulls ERC20 fees using SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom.
callOptionalReturn performs a low-level call on the token, bypassing return-data size checks.
mintOnDeposit relies on msg.sender matching the lending pool address via onlyLendingPool.
redeem cumulates, burns and pays out for msg.sender.
AToken.redeem calls pool.redeemUnderlying to release the underlying asset.
AToken.redeem cumulates the caller balance through cumulateBalanceInternal.
amountToRedeem bounds the burned amount and the amount sent to the pool.
mintOnDeposit cumulates the account balance before minting.
burnOnLiquidation cumulates the account balance before burning.
transferOnLiquidation routes through executeTransferInternal.
redirectInterestStream redirects the interest of msg.sender.
redirectInterestStreamInternal cumulates the source balance before changing redirection.
The _to parameter becomes the new interest redirection target recorded in storage.
executeTransferInternal cumulates both sender and receiver balances.
cumulateBalanceInternal writes the refreshed reserve index into userIndexes.
deposit reads the core contract reference to reach the reserve and aToken.
deposit relies on addressesProvider-derived component addresses stored at initialization.
updateStateOnBorrow mutates the reserves mapping with compounding and new borrow amounts.
updateStateOnBorrow writes the borrower record in usersReserveData.
cumulateBalanceInternal reads the underlying asset to fetch the normalized income.
cumulateBalanceInternal reads and updates the stored user index.
executeTransferInternal adjusts redirectedBalances of sender and receiver.
redirectInterestStream reads and writes the interestRedirectionAddresses mapping.
The nonReentrant modifier increments and compares _guardCounter to detect reentrancy.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner authorizes the caller based on msg.sender equality with the owner.
executeTransferInternal ultimately moves principal balances stored in ERC20._balances.
The _reserve parameter selects the reserve affected by the deposit.
The _amount parameter determines the minted aTokens and the funds moved into the core.
The _receiver parameter is cast to IFlashLoanReceiver and called back by the pool.
The _amount parameter determines the liquidity transferred and the fee computed.
The _params blob is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted receiver callback.
The _amount parameter is clamped against the current balance before burning.
The _account parameter receives the minted aTokens on deposit.
BorrowLocalVars holds intermediate collateral, fee and rate computations used by borrow.
localCounter snapshots the guard counter for the post-execution reentrancy assertion.
setUserUseReserveAsCollateral writes the collateral flag in usersReserveData.

normalization_plan.reason: Simple input selector for the deposit function; carries no independent value beyond the call it feeds.
Scalar deposit amount fully consumed by the deposit routine.
Receiver address only meaningful as the callback target of flashLoan.
Flash loan amount is consumed entirely inside flashLoan for transfer and fee computation.
Opaque calldata forwarded directly to the receiver; no separate semantics.
Redirection destination is only used to update interestRedirectionAddresses within the routine.
Redeem amount is normalized into amountToRedeem inside the redeem function.
Mint beneficiary is consumed directly by the only-pool mint routine.
Temporary snapshot used only for the flash loan repayment invariant check.
Fee intermediate used solely to validate and settle the flash loan.
Protocol fee slice computed and passed to core.updateStateOnFlashLoan within flashLoan.
Stack-too-deep scaffolding struct whose fields are all local to the borrow flow.
Derived redeem quantity local to the redeem computation.
Guard snapshot value exists only to implement the nonReentrant reentrancy check.
